data.action: 侧卧于墨玉榻，黑袍半敞露锁骨香肩，指尖流转墨痕，金眸含笑凝望前方观众
data.camera: from front, facing viewer, looking directly at viewer, eye contact, cowboy shot, eye level
data.description: 画中天地无边无际，无数泼墨山水卷轴在虚空中静静悬浮流转。夕独自侧卧在卷轴环绕的墨玉榻上，宽大的黑色袍服松垮半敞，露出精致修长的锁骨与雪白如玉的肩项。青黑色的龙角在画境幽光中泛着青芒，指尖萦绕着点点未散的墨韵微尘。她侧头迎向你的视线，眸光深邃而灵动，仿佛整座墨色乾坤都抵不过眼前之人的一瞥。
data.lighting: 卷轴画境冷月光芒与墨玉榻幽光
data.mood: 画中岁月的超然与沉醉
data.promptProse: Dusk reclines gracefully on an ink-stone daybed facing the viewer, her draped black silk robe parted to reveal her bare shoulders, collarbone, cleavage, and slender bare legs; floating scrolls and painterly mist surround her under ethereal lantern glow.
data.title: 夕 · 墨夜画卷
data.animaCaption: Reclining on the stone daybed facing the viewer, her parted silk robe reveals her collarbone, cleavage, and bare legs among floating ink scrolls.
